results.title: Russia turns to Asia for refined fuel, set to receive nearly 270,000 tonnes in Aug
results.description: Russia is importing refined fuel from Asian nations this month. Ukrainian attacks on its oil refineries have reduced domestic fuel production significantly. India supplies about one-third of these crucial refined fuel imports. These shipments use ship-to-ship transfers to obscure their origins. Russia has also tightened its own fuel export curbs to manage shortages.

results.title: Gadkari Says No Compromise on Quality of Road Projects
results.description: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari has warned contractors that poor-quality road work could lead to strict action and exclusion from future government tenders. He also highlighted defective Detailed Project Reports as a major concern affecting road safety and contributing to accidents.

results.title: Trump looks set to tap White House aide Heidi Overton as next FDA commissioner
results.description: After three months without a permanent leader in place, President Donald Trump looks set to name a new commissioner of the FDA. Heidi Overton, M.D., Ph.D., currently a White House aide, will go before the Senate in an effort to secure the job of the country’s top drug regulator, based on Fierce's understanding of the situation.

results.title: Vijay government makes U-turn, withdraws order barring students from CJP, Left protests
results.description: The Vijay-led Tamil Nadu government has withdrawn an order that sought to prevent students from joining protests organised by Left parties and the Cockroach Janata Party. The decision came after the directive faced strong criticism from the CJP, although the BJP supported it.
